summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Alive Launchpad. Backend: 27/27 pytest tests passed (tokens list w/ 8 seeded, avatar stats=1262, archetype filter+pagination, commander vibe generation + reroll, token lifecycle: create→metadata→mock launch→live, lab session, all 12 sim actions + set_mcap + launch, WebSocket hello + event streaming on whale_buy, pumpportal/prepare image requirement + success with tx base64, launch/link invalid mint 400, sim rejects non-sim mint). Frontend: Home page renders with hero-create-cta, live-tokens-grid, 8 token cards (LOCK/DESK/NEWS/DEVIL/PROBE/HONK/ROOT/MOONLAB), 3D stage canvas renders, LOCK card navigates to /token/SIM... page showing stage, LISTENING status, ENTER LIVE, stat-mcap, trade-stream-feed, memory-panel, simulated-notice, market chart. Character Lab: all selectors + 12 sim buttons + say/mcap/relaunch all present, dialogue log updates after whale_buy sim, memory updates (ATH, biggest buy). Create flow: fill form → generate (preview name shown) → reroll (name changes) → open launch dialog → mock launch → navigates to /token/SIM..pump. Explore page: search filter, 4 sort buttons, registry tab + pagination all work. Mobile 390px: stage renders first and large.

issues: Recharts prints a warning at mount: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart still renders fine once container has layout, but worth adding a minHeight/minWidth guard on the ResponsiveContainer parent to silence the warning.

action_items: Optional: wrap market chart <ResponsiveContainer> parent with explicit minHeight to eliminate the width(-1) warning.

Note: emotion-button data-testids are lowercase in CharacterLab (emotion-button-idle, …). The review request referenced uppercase (emotion-button-IDLE). Lowercase is more conventional — recommend keeping lowercase and updating docs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 676 lines and starts to span many concerns (storage, auth, tokens, launch, lab, websocket, seed). Consider splitting into routers (tokens.py, launch.py, avatars.py, lab.py) once functionality stabilizes.
launch_mock accepts tokenId from body but does not validate ownership vs creatorWallet — if auth is added later, mock launch should enforce creator permission.

pumpportal/prepare sets status=pending BEFORE verifying the client ever signs; a stale 'pending' token can block retries. Consider idempotency: allow re-prepare if status==pending and signature is null.
simulate() for non-simulated mint returns 400 'Simulation only allowed on simulated tokens' which is correct — good.
/api/sim/{mint}/ with a trailing slash returns 405 (FastAPI's route treats trailing-slash differently). Consider adding redirect_slashes behavior or documenting.
seed_data_creation: Created a few QA tokens via POST /api/tokens (names starting 'QA ...', tickers QATEST/QAIMG/QALINK/QACREATE). Mock-launched some, so they appear in /tokens list. Also created a few LAB... sessions via /lab/session. These are expected/acceptable per the review note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers tokens list, avatars (stats+filter), character generate+reroll, token lifecycle (create→metadata→mock launch), lab session, all 12 sim actions, websocket hello+events, pumpportal/prepare (image required + success path tolerant of 502), launch/link invalid mint. Reuse with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. WebSocket tests use the websockets package. Frontend data-testids verified for Home, Token page, Character Lab, Create, Explore. Note emotion-button-* testids are lowercase (idle/thinking/...).
rca_of_the_issue: No critical issues. Minor Recharts width warning is cosmetic (container animates in). Trailing-slash on /api/sim/{mint}/ yields 405 due to FastAPI route matching — expected unless redirect_slashes is enabled.
